register_symbolic_function: register a symbolic function for an ONNX op using the onnx_symbolic decorator with a given opset version
register_custom_symbolic: register a custom symbolic function that overrides an existing ONNX op using the custom_onnx_symbolic decorator
override_builtin_function: override a built-in ONNX symbolic function with a custom implementation using OverrideDict
unregister_custom_function: unregister a custom ONNX symbolic function by removing its override from the SymbolicRegistry
lookup_dispatched_opset: find the best matching registered opset version for a target ONNX opset using _dispatch_opset_version
